Our process

How we work

  1. 1

    Assess

    We map your data, processes and goals to find where AI pays off.

  2. 2

    Design

    We define the solution, success metrics and a realistic plan.

  3. 3

    Build

    We develop, test and deploy working AI alongside your team.

  4. 4

    Enable

    We train your people so they own and extend what we built.

Operate & improve

We monitor, evaluate and improve what we built, or hand it to your team with runbooks.

The kinds of systems we build

Illustrative example

Professional services

Agentic document intake

Challenge
Client documents arrive by email in many formats and are keyed in by hand.
System
Agents classify and extract each document into the practice-management system, with a person approving anything uncertain.
Observed and sustained
Every document is traced end to end, with an accuracy evaluation set and a weekly review queue.

Illustrative example of an engagement type, not a client case study.

Illustrative example

Manufacturing

Connected maintenance forecasting

Challenge
Machine sensor data, the maintenance system and the ERP never talk to each other.
System
A forecasting pipeline that joins all three and schedules maintenance work orders.
Observed and sustained
Data-quality and drift monitors, model retraining runbooks and an owner on the client's team.

Illustrative example of an engagement type, not a client case study.

Illustrative example

Retail

Customer service copilot

Challenge
Support staff search several systems to answer each question.
System
A retrieval-augmented assistant over the product catalog, order system and policies that drafts answers for staff.
Observed and sustained
Answer-quality evaluations, cost per conversation tracked, and guardrails reviewed monthly.
